title: judge-runner ledger record (superset schema v1)
description: One record per (item, arm, attempt). Union of the 17-judge-calib record with the d2-P1 extensions (em_correct/agree/abstained/category) and runner columns (head/arm/attempt/swap_agree/votes/unanimous). Metrics stay per-head; the ledger is the only shared surface.

arm.description: blind arm label, stripped at grade time, unblinded in analysis

verdict.description: per-head verdict object (listwise: {relevant_ids}; h1: {dims}); null when error

error.description: free-text detail (taxonomy class + cause); null on success

votes.description: H5: verdict list from the n=3 majority; null otherwise

error.description: NEEDS-WORK taxonomy: error != null after 2 attempts is a NEEDS-WORK row, never a guessed grade
